primeros-pasos.title: Getting started
primeros-pasos.summary: Your account, your team and how to log in.

q1.q: How do I create my account and agency?
q1.a: From “Sign up” you create your user and your agency's name, and you're in the dashboard. Your dashboard's address carries your agency's name.

q2.q: How do I add my team?
q2.a: In Team you add people and give them a role: owner, administrator or agent. Only owners and administrators see that section.

q3.q: I forgot my password. What do I do?
q3.a: On the login screen use the option to recover your password. We'll email you a link to create a new one.

q4.a: For security, sessions expire after a while and you need to log in again. Nothing you've saved is lost.

q1.q: How do I add a property?
q1.a: In Properties you create a new one, fill in the details, upload the photos (they're resized automatically before uploading) and publish it when it's ready.

q2.q: How do I assign a property to an agent?
q2.a: Owners and administrators can choose who's in charge of each property. Agents only see the ones assigned to them.

q3.q: Does everything I add show on my website?
q3.a: The properties you publish are shown. Whatever you leave unpublished stays in the dashboard only.

clientes-consultas.title: Clients and inquiries
clientes-consultas.summary: From the first inquiry to the follow-up.

q1.q: Where do inquiries from my website go?
q1.a: To the Inquiries inbox. Each one creates a client (or reuses the one with that email), leaves a note with the property they looked at and adds to the counter in the menu.

q2.q: How am I notified of a new inquiry?
q2.a: By email to the agency (to the contact email or, if there isn't one, to owners and administrators) and with the bell in the dashboard. The client gets a confirmation.

q3.q: How do I follow up with a client?
q3.a: Inside each client you can create tasks with a date and an assignee. You can also view everyone as a board and drag them from one stage to another.

ofertas.title: Offers
ofertas.summary: Building them, sharing them and knowing if they were opened.

q1.q: How do I send an offer to a client?
q1.a: You build the offer with one or more properties, discounts and services, and share the link. The client sees it without creating an account.

q2.q: How do I know if my offer was opened?
q2.a: The bell lets you know as soon as it's opened. On the offer you also see when it was viewed and when it expires.

reservas-cobros.title: Bookings and payments
reservas-cobros.summary: Dates, payments and what the client sees.

q1.q: What does the client see of their booking?
q1.a: A link by email, sent when the booking is created, confirmed or cancelled, with their dates, the total and the payment status. It doesn't show the commission.

q2.q: How do I record a payment?
q2.a: In the booking you enter the deposit and the balance with their status. You see what's collected, what's left and the commission.

q3.a: An unconfirmed booking. It shows on the calendar so you see it coming, but it doesn't block the dates yet.

disponibilidad.title: Availability and rates
disponibilidad.summary: The calendar for your holiday rentals.

q1.a: In Availability, month view: pick a property and drag across the free nights. Booked nights can't be changed.

q2.q: How do I set seasonal rates?
q2.a: On each property you define periods with their nightly price. The booking total is calculated from those values.

q3.q: Can I see only the properties free on certain dates?
q3.a: Yes. In Availability you choose a date range and a location, and it shows only the ones that are free.

sitio-portales.title: Website and portals
sitio-portales.summary: Your public website and the links for owners.

q1.q: How do I customise my agency's website?
q1.a: In Website you choose the template, colours, typefaces and blocks, and see how it looks on desktop, tablet and mobile before publishing.

q2.q: Can I use my own domain?
q2.a: Not yet. Your website lives on a Tivvu subdomain with your agency's name.

q3.q: What does the owner see in their portal?
q3.a: Their properties, bookings and payments, with what was collected, the payouts and the balance. The commission stays hidden unless you show it from Settings.

cuenta-datos.title: Account and data
cuenta-datos.summary: Who sees what and how we look after your information.

q1.q: Is my data mixed with other agencies' data?
q1.a: No. Each agency works in its own space and only its team sees its properties, clients and bookings.

q2.q: What does each person on my team see?
q2.a: Agents see their properties, offers and bookings, their clients and unassigned inquiries. Owners and administrators see everything and reassign.

q3.q: How do I exercise my rights over my data?
q3.a: It's explained in the Privacy policy, along with the email address to write to.
